card.name: The word for after a result figure
card.fires_on: The word "for" right after a number, percentage or range in clinical trial results, introducing the group the figure applies to (placebo, a named drug, or a patient group).

modes.label: For placebo group
modes.description: "for" follows a measured value or rate and is followed by placebo.

modes.label: For treated patients
modes.description: "for" follows a number or range and introduces patients treated with a named drug.
modes.example: The median time to onset of fracture was 56 days (range: 2 to 111 days)<< for>> patients treated with ERLEADA. Routine
